title: Managing Job Stages - Job Tracker
description:
LIKE & SUBSCRIBE for you more Resume, Job Search & Career Growth content!

Unlock the secrets of effective job tracking! In this video, I’ll guide you through the various stages of managing your job applications using our platform.  Whether you’re juggling a handful or hundreds of opportunities, knowing where each job stands is crucial for your success. 

What We Will Cover: 
- Understanding job stages (Bookmarked, Applying, Interviewing, Negotiating, Accepted) 
- How to manage your bookmarked jobs  
- Insights on the applying stage 
- Overview of the interviewing process and tools  
- Tips for negotiating job offers  
- Archiving and managing jobs you no longer pursue 

Questions Answered in This Video: 
- What are the different job stages and how do they work? 
- How can I organize my jobs in the tracker effectively? 
- What do I do with jobs I’m not pursuing anymore? 
- How can I track interviews and feedback efficiently? 
- What happens to archived jobs and how do I recover them?
